Nodes are the logistics network's capillaries — choosing right beats piling more: the steam and fluid families each come in three tiers, capacity and rate stepping up together, with adjustable rate steps to fine-tune for each downstream's appetite — numbers in the tooltip.

Binding costs vary by tier: some run §dzero-singularity§r, stronger tiers burn more, and the overpressure tier wants hub and chips all in place — the price list lives in the tooltips.
